name: Recycling
description: The software project will develop a user-friendly web application that allows users to discover and manage recycling facilities. Key features include searching for nearby centers by zip code, viewing operational hours, accessing maps of recycling locations, and receiving notifications about events. Administrators will manage facility information and user feedback, ensuring data security while enabling communication between facility representatives and site admins to improve community recycling efforts.
rawDescription: The software project will develop a user-friendly web application that allows users to discover and manage recycling facilities. Key features include searching for nearby centers by zip code, viewing operational hours, accessing maps of recycling locations, and receiving notifications about events. Administrators will manage facility information and user feedback, ensuring data security while enabling communication between facility representatives and site admins to improve community recycling efforts.
highLevelGoals: Provide a seamless search experience for users to find recycling centers based on their location, supporting environmental responsibility and convenience.
Allow users to view operational hours and map-based navigation to facilitate timely and informed visits to recycling centers.
Deliver timely notifications to users regarding community recycling events, facility changes, or promotions to increase participation.
Ensure administrators can manage and verify facility information to maintain data integrity and support community recycling efforts.
Allow administrators to review, categorize, and respond to user feedback to improve service quality and user satisfaction.
Enable facility representatives to communicate with administrators to coordinate updates, resolve issues, and enhance recycling operations.
Protect user and facility data through secure systems and access controls to maintain trust and compliance with data regulations.
lowLevelGoals: User initiates a search query using their current GPS coordinates to find nearby recycling centers.
User clicks on a facility result to view its address, phone number, and website for further information.
User views the operational hours of a selected recycling facility to plan their visit accordingly.
User triggers navigation to the selected facility using integrated map services (e.g., Google Maps or Apple Maps).
User receives a push notification about a nearby recycling event based on their location and preferences.
User receives in-app alerts about facility closures, new services, or operational changes.
Administrator edits facility details such as address, hours, or contact info through the admin interface.
Administrator assigns a category (e.g., 'incorrect info', 'out of service') and priority level to user-submitted feedback.
Administrator sends a response to the user via in-app message or email confirming action taken on their feedback.
Facility Representative submits updates or reports about facility status, changes, or issues to the system.
Administrator sends a message or request to a facility representative to coordinate updates or resolve issues.
Administrator receives and replies to messages from facility representatives regarding facility status or updates.
Administrator sets role-based access controls for user data (e.g., read-only, edit, admin) via the system settings.
Administrator reviews system logs to track who accessed or modified data and when.

baselineCritiques.actors: The actors defined are appropriate for the described software system. All relevant roles (User, Administrator, Facility Representative) are included without any omissions or contradictions. The names accurately reflect their responsibilities as per the description.
baselineCritiques.highLevelGoals: The high-level goals are well-defined, functional, and aligned with the software description. All key features (searching, operational hours, maps, notifications) are covered, and the goals for each actor (User, Administrator, Facility Representative) are appropriate. No contradictions or omissions are detected.
baselineCritiques.lowLevelGoals: The low-level goals are well-aligned with the high-level goals and actors, covering all functional aspects of the software. However, there is a minor redundancy in the "Facilitate communication" goal under [Administrator], where both initiating communication and responding to messages could be consolidated into a single goal (e.g., "Manage two-way communication between facility representatives and administrators"). Additionally, the low-level goals for notifications (push notifications and in-app alerts) are slightly overlapping but serve distinct purposes (events vs. updates), so they can remain separate. No major omissions or contradictions were found.
